description: Codex installs a plugin bundle and then needs an explicit bootstrap: install.py materializes the generated TOMLs into the project's or user's .codex/agents, because Codex does not read a plugin's agents from the bundle the way Claude Code reads agents/. So this bundle ships install.py at its root, and everything install.py reads - roles/, hosts/codex.json, schemas/, scripts/ and references/ - travels with it. A bundle that carried the agents but not the means to install them would be a directory nobody can act on. bundle_root is '.' because .codex-plugin/plugin.json sits at the top of the bundle. Every source is written repository-root-relative, matching adapters/claude-code/layout.json: a mixture of spellings breaks the lookup that maps a source to its placed copy inside a bundle.
